{{Top|leg}}
[[File:ChewieTCW-SWSB.png|thumb|right|250px|Chewbacca wearing a baldric]]
A '''baldric''' was a belt worn over one's shoulders. It was worn by members of various [[Species/Legends|species]], including [[Viidaav (species)|Viidaav]], [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]], and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. Baldrics were very important to Wookiee culture; a Wookiee earned the right to wear a baldric after completing a [[Hrrtayyk ceremony/Legends|hrrtayyk ceremony]].
